{{Quote|At Muunilinst, a three-way fleet battle rages among forces loyal to Head of State Fel and Moffs Woolbam and Callron the Younger.|A newscaster, during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]]|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
A '''battle''' took place in the [[Muunilinst system/Legends|Muunilinst system]] in [[44 ABY]]. During the last stages of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] and a number of rebellious [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] attempted a coup to overthrow [[Jagged Fel]], the rightful [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. During the one-month long [[Battle over Exodo II]] that opposed Fel's and Daala's fleets, numerous troubles erupted in [[Imperial Space]]. As most element of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]] were involved in the battle, traitorous Moffs used the opportunity to settle old disputes and expand their territories by attacking rival Imperial [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. At Muunilinst, a three-way battle was fought by an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] loyal to Head of State Fel against the forces of Moffs [[Woolbam]] and [[Callron]] the Younger. This disastrous situation in Imperial space eventually led to the organization of a [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|general Imperial election]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
